# EasyUI

MIT source from [easyui.site](https://easyui.site) / [Surajmaurya1/easyui](https://github.com/Surajmaurya1/easyui). License: `LICENSE` in this folder.

One component per file in `ui/`. Shared helpers are in `lib/` (`cn`, motion tokens, chart primitives). The command menu reads `registry/catalog-index.ts`.

```tsx
import { MagneticButton } from "@/components/external/easyui/ui/MagneticButton"
```

131 components. No paid tier.
